drums.description: Hard rock with heavy metal influences, Distorted electric guitars play a palm-muted, syncopated riff centered on E, The drum kit features a prominent double-kick pedal pattern with rapid sixteenth-note bursts, A high-gain bass guitar mirrors the guitar riff with a gritty, overdriven tone, The tempo is 140 BPM in 4/4 time, The arrangement focuses on a rhythmic chugging pattern using down-tuned strings, characterized by a sharp attack and quick decay on the palm-muted notes, Cymbals are used for frequent accents on the off-beats Publish

bass.description: Experimental electronic and industrial noise, The track features a heavily distorted, low-frequency synth pulse that functions as a rhythmic anchor, A metallic, resonant percussion sound occurs on the downbeat, processed with long-tail industrial reverb, High-frequency digital glitches and white noise bursts are panned aggressively across the stereo field, A granular synthesis engine processes a mechanical whirring sound, creating a shifting, abrasive texture, The tempo is 100 BPM in 4/4 time, The harmonic content is minimal, focusing on a single dissonant drone in the key of C minor Publish
